# Version 4.151.4
> **Windows native asset compliance** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.104/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.4 removes the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007** — Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5122](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5122))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.104

The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.
